en.title: Future continuous and future perfect
en.summary: The future continuous shows an action in progress; the future perfect shows one that will be finished.

paragraphs: The future continuous describes an action in progress at a future time. The future perfect describes an action that will be finished by a future time.

items: This time tomorrow I **will be flying**.

paragraphs: Form the future continuous with will be and the -ing form. Form the future perfect with will have and the past participle. By marks the time limit.

blocks.html:
FormExample
future continuousHe will be working at five.
future perfectHe will have finished by five.
